comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This item can be obtained from the Well-Dressed Gentleman once per character up until April 24th's maintenance period.

Source: uwo.papayaplay.com/uwo.do?tp=news.view&postid=4995

The Gent can be found at any tavern/rest house in cities where quest mediators are found (IE, Marseilles, London, Athens, Aden, etc.) -- cheers, great online voyaging to you.
